name: Knack
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Knack, build a small hosted database app with pages, forms, and role-based views. The hard boundary is managed hosting, schema builder, permissions, integrations, and support, plus data model flexibility, collaboration, and integrations.
